# Report information

Focused **LC-MS / identification QC** report (RT / 1k0 / m/z distributions,
Score and mass-error QC, PTM profile) for immunopeptidomics experiments,
provided by the Immunopeptidomics Platform (IPP). Intended for advanced users.

**Sample Set:** `r params$SampleSet`

**Data Analysis: ** `r params$DataAnalysisNames`

**Date:**  `r Sys.Date()`

**Code version:** `r packageVersion("HowMaHiCo")`

```{r child = system.file("rmarkdown", "shared", "setup.Rmd", package = "HowMaHiCo")}
```


# Peptide ID distribution across RT, 1/k0 and m/z {.tabset}

```{r lcms-dist-config, echo=FALSE}
# Each "view" is one inner tab: a label + a builder closure (df, title) -> plot.
# The first view is a pseudochromatogram; the other three are 2D density maps.
lcms_views <- list(
  chromato = list(
    tab = "n_Peptides Vs RT (Pseudochromatograms)",
    fun = function(df, title) plot_pseudochromatogram(df, paste0("Peptide ID chromatogram: ", title), ncol = phis_ncol)),
  invk0_mz = list(
    tab = "1/k0 VS m/z",
    fun = function(df, title) plot_2d_distribution(df, "m_z", "invk0", c(10, 0.025), title, x_lab = "m/z", y_lab = "1/k0", ncol = phis_ncol)),
  invk0_rt = list(
    tab = "1/k0 VS RT",
    fun = function(df, title) plot_2d_distribution(df, "RT", "invk0", c(1, 0.025), title, x_lab = "RT (min)", y_lab = "1/k0", ncol = phis_ncol)),
  mz_rt = list(
    tab = "m/z VS RT",
    fun = function(df, title) plot_2d_distribution(df, "RT", "m_z", c(1, 10), title, x_lab = "RT (min)", y_lab = "m/z", ncol = phis_ncol))
)

lcms_sets <- list(
  all   = list(name  = "All peptides",
               df    = pep_all,
               title = "All peptides identified"),
  short = list(name  = paste0("Selected peptides (", shortpep_range[1], " to ", shortpep_range[2], " AAs)"),
               df    = pep_short,
               title = paste0("Selected peptides (", shortpep_range[1], " to ", shortpep_range[2], " AAs)"))
)

lcms_dist_plots <- list()  # collected for the export block
```

```{r plot-lcms-dist, results='asis', echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=4, warning=FALSE}
for (set_key in names(lcms_sets)) {
  s <- lcms_sets[[set_key]]
  cat("\n## ", s$name, " {.tabset}\n")
  for (view_key in names(lcms_views)) {
    v <- lcms_views[[view_key]]
    cat("\n### ", v$tab, "\n")
    p <- v$fun(s$df, s$title)
    print(p)
    lcms_dist_plots[[paste0(view_key, "_", set_key)]] <- p
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```


# Identification QC

## Score per Condition {.tabset}

### Violin & boxplots

```{r plot-qc-score-violin, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
vp_score_score <- plot_qc_violin(pep_all, "Score", "Score distribution, and boxplot")
vp_score_score
```

### Boxplots

```{r plot-qc-score-box, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
bp_score_score <- plot_qc_box(pep_all, "Score", "Score boxplot")
bp_score_score
```

## Mass eror per condition and charge {.tabset}

### Violin & boxplots

```{r plot-qc-masserror-violin, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
vp_masserror_ppm <- plot_qc_violin(pep_all, "ppm", "Mass error distribution, and boxplot")
vp_masserror_ppm
```

### Boxplots alone

```{r plot-qc-masserror-box, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
bp_masserror_ppm <- plot_qc_box(pep_all, "ppm", "Mass error boxplot")
bp_masserror_ppm
```


```{r export-results, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
write_input_params(params, folder = FolderResults, prefix = "03_lcms_qc")

if (params$PlotsSave) {
  for (nm in names(lcms_dist_plots)) {
    ggsave_rawr(lcms_dist_plots[[nm]], file = nm, folder = FolderFigures,
                width = n_conditions + 8, height = 12)
  }
  ggsave_rawr(vp_score_score, file = "vp_score_score", folder = FolderFigures, width = 20, height = 12)
  ggsave_rawr(vp_masserror_ppm, file = "vp_masserror_ppm", folder = FolderFigures, width = 20, height = 12)
  ggsave_rawr(bp_score_score, file = "bp_score_score", folder = FolderFigures, width = 20, height = 12)
  ggsave_rawr(bp_masserror_ppm, file = "bp_masserror_ppm", folder = FolderFigures, width = 20, height = 12)
}
```
